# Bid the lid, the hose, and the extra gallons.

> Price a septic tank pump from buried lids, hose run, extra tanks, baffles, risers, inspection, dump tickets, and after-hours dispatch — not a published $325 pump special. See the walk-away number before you match a cheaper per-gallon quote.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
